# self description
Clinical Nutritionist and Master’s Candidate in Clinical Nutrition, focused on Oncology Nutrition and Body Composition Research at Instituto Nacional de Cancerología (INCan), Mexico.
:::

I am a nutrition professional interested in the interaction between metabolism, inflammation, skeletal muscle, and cancer outcomes. My current work focuses on women with endometrial cancer, evaluating how nutrition and physical activity interventions may influence muscle mass, functionality, and circulating exerkines before surgery.

My long-term goal is to continue into doctoral training and contribute to the advancement of nutrition in oncology.

## Publications
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(RefManageR)

# 1. Load your master references.bib file
bib <- ReadBib("/Users/os/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/OMC Lab/website/OMC.Lab/publications.bib")

# 2. Helper function to ignore accents, hyphens, and case
normalize_text <- function(text) {
  text <- tolower(text)
  text <- chartr("áéíóúñü", "aeiounu", text)
  text <- gsub("-", " ", text)
  return(text)
}

# 3. Define who you are looking for
target_author <- "landa esquivias"

# 4. Search the bib file
idx <- sapply(bib, function(entry) {
  authors_str <- paste(format(entry$author), collapse = " ")
  clean_authors <- normalize_text(authors_str)
  grepl(target_author, clean_authors, fixed = TRUE)
})

# 5. Check if we found anything
if (sum(idx) > 0) {
  # Subset to only the author's papers
  author_bib <- bib[idx]
  
  # 6. Extract years safely (assigns year 0 if a year is missing so it doesn't break)
  years <- sapply(author_bib, function(x) {
    if (is.null(x$year)) return(0) else return(as.numeric(x$year))
  })
  
  # Sort the list descending by year
  author_bib <- author_bib[order(years, decreasing = TRUE)]
  
  # 7. Print the formatted references AND stop it from re-sorting alphabetically!
  print(author_bib, .opts = list(style = "markdown", 
                                 bib.style = "authoryear", 
                                 sorting = "none"))
  
} else {
  # Print this if no matches are found
  cat("not yet, but working on it")
}
```
